## Limitations and review

- [ ] One coherent, independently mergeable outcome
- [ ] Relevant boundary and failure behavior is tested
- [ ] Units, samples, windows, direction and missingness remain explicit
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility guidance are current
- [ ] No lint-suppression comments added merely to silence findings
- [ ] No secrets, machine-specific paths or unrelated churn
- [ ] No unapproved external side effects or publication
